# AgentFS

> Portable identity layer for AI agents. Mount your agent's soul, memory, and skills as a FUSE filesystem — carry it across any environment with one command.

AgentFS is an open-source Go project that solves the "context loss" problem in AI agent development. Every time an agent moves to a new environment (different machine, sandbox, or session), it loses its memory, personality, and skills. AgentFS packages this state as a mountable FUSE filesystem so the agent always knows who it is and what it remembers.

## Key concept

```
agentfs mount ./my-agent /agentfs
```

The agent reads `/agentfs/soul.md` at startup (its personality + instructions). Memory is appended to `/agentfs/mem/episodic.jsonl`. Skills live in `/agentfs/skills/`. The kernel enforces permissions — agents cannot overwrite their own identity.

## File layout

- `agentfs.yaml` — manifest (name, version, description)
- `soul.md` — agent identity, read-only to agent, YAML frontmatter + Markdown body
- `mem/episodic.jsonl` — append-only structured memory log (one JSON object per line)
- `skills/` — SKILL.md capability files, read-only to agent
- `logs/` — read-write audit trail

## Permission model

| Path | Agent | Human |
|------|-------|-------|
| soul.md | read-only | editable |
| mem/episodic.jsonl | append-only | editable |
| skills/*.md | read-only | editable |
| logs/* | read + write | read |

## Integration (2 lines)

```python
# Inject identity at startup
soul = open("/agentfs/soul.md").read()
system_prompt = soul + "\n\n" + your_base_prompt

# Persist memory
import json, datetime
with open("/agentfs/mem/episodic.jsonl", "a") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"ts": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+"Z", "text": "..."}) + "\n")
```

## Technical details

- Language: Go 1.26
- FUSE library: hanwen/go-fuse v2
- Platform: Linux (FUSE kernel module required); macOS via Docker
- Concurrency: mutex-protected writes, race-tested with `go test -race`
- Crash recovery: on mount, truncates episodic.jsonl to last complete newline
- License: MIT

- GitHub: https://github.com/Airine/agent-fuse

## Related projects

- AgentFS by Turso — SQLite-backed agent filesystem (different approach, no soul/identity concept)
- Hermes Agent (Nous Research) — persistent memory + auto-generated skills
- AgentFS differs by treating the entire identity as a portable filesystem unit with kernel-enforced permissions
